packageRules.description: Workflow dotnet-version inputs install supported target runtimes; global.json owns SDK upgrades.
Allocation diagnostics and frozen controls keep the runner image used by their historical baselines; change it only with deliberate re-baselining.
net10.0 pins of packages released with .NET stay on 10.x; the net11.0 pins in Directory.Packages.props take the next major.
Dependency updates use the repository's draft review lifecycle, overriding inherited automerge rules.
